response.overview: October 8th 2022 marks the second anniversary of my Grandfather's death. Throughout those 2 years barely anything stayed the same. Yet, his iPhone 5s that he bought from Qatar back in 2013 where he lived during his last few years remained untouched. This almost obsolete device gives me an opportunity to re-identify my grandfather through the gaze of social media memes, screenshots and poorly taken selfies.
response.title: اي-فون جدي
